# Early Bird

> Early Bird (https://eatearlybird.com) lists restaurants in Los Angeles and New York that give 50% off the food bill when you book an early or quiet-time table. Drinks are full price. Diners pay a small booking fee per person to hold the table; the discount is taken off the bill at the restaurant. Book on the website.

## Key pages

- [Book a table](https://eatearlybird.com/book/): live restaurants and open times (interactive app)
- [Restaurant deals in New York](https://eatearlybird.com/new-york/)
- [Restaurant deals in Los Angeles](https://eatearlybird.com/los-angeles/)
- [For restaurants](https://eatearlybird.com/restaurants/): list early tables for free
- [Terms](https://eatearlybird.com/terms.html), [Privacy](https://eatearlybird.com/privacy.html), [Support](https://eatearlybird.com/support.html)

## Book from an AI assistant

- MCP server (Streamable HTTP, no sign-in for search): https://mcp.eatearlybird.com
  Tools: search_deals, restaurant, availability, start_booking (returns a link to Early Bird's checkout; payment is never taken in chat).
